modelIdentification.name: RestaurantExample
modelIdentification.purpose: To define an HLA object model for a restaurant federate
modelIdentification.description: This object model is intended to define the external HLA interface of the "Joe's Place" restaurant simulation.
modelIdentification.other: See Mobil International Restaurant Guide for more information

objectClass.name: Bill
objectClass.semantics: Statement of money owed by the customer

objectClass.name: Order
objectClass.semantics: Specific items requested by a customer

objectClass.name: Employee
objectClass.semantics: A person working for the restaurant

attribute.name: PayRate
attribute.semantics: Amount the employee is paid per hour

attribute.name: YearsOfService
attribute.semantics: Number of years the employee has worked for the restaurant

objectClass.name: Dishwasher
objectClass.semantics: Cleaner of plates, pots, and utensils

objectClass.name: SideDish
objectClass.semantics: A dish served as subsidiary to the main one.

interactionClass.name: CustomerTransactions
interactionClass.semantics: The base class of interactions between customers and employee

parameter.name: TemperatureOk
parameter.semantics: Whether the food was the correct temperature

parameter.name: AccuracyOk
parameter.semantics: Whether the correct food was served

parameter.name: TimelinessOk
parameter.semantics: Whether the food was served in a reasonable amount of time

dimension.name: SodaFlavor
dimension.outputDataSemantics: Map the flavor of soda ordered to an enumeration

dimension.name: BarQuantity
dimension.outputDataSemantics: Number of drinks in an order

dimension.name: Sweetener
dimension.outputDataSemantics: The type of drink sweetener that was used in soda

dimension.name: ServerId
dimension.outputDataSemantics: A federation-unique identifier for each server

dimension.name: Gluten
dimension.inputDataDescription: The list of ingredients, whether the dish is modifiable to remove each ingredient, and whether the kitchen has separate preparation facilities
dimension.outputDataSemantics: An enumeration indicating whether the dish is safe for gluten intolerant, Celiac, or wheat allergy

synchronizationPoint.label: InitialPublish
synchronizationPoint.semantics: Achieved when all classes are published and subscribed, and all initially present objects are registered

synchronizationPoint.label: InitialUpdate
synchronizationPoint.semantics: Achieved when instance attribute values for all initially present objects are updated

synchronizationPoint.label: BeginTimeAdvance
synchronizationPoint.semantics: Achieved when time management services are invoked

synchronizationPoint.label: PauseExecution
synchronizationPoint.semantics: Achieved when the time advance after the time in the user-supplied tag is attained; time advance requests should then cease

transportation.name: HLAreliable
transportation.semantics: Provide reliable delivery of data in the sense that TCP/IP delivers its data reliably

transportation.name: HLAbestEffort
transportation.semantics: Make an effort to deliver data in the sense that UDP provides best-effort delivery

transportation.name: PriorityBestEffort
transportation.semantics: Deliver best effort data with higher priority than HLAbestEffort

enumeratedData.name: GlutenLevel
enumeratedData.semantics: Possible levels of gluten removability from an ingredients list

enumeratedData.name: SweetenerType
enumeratedData.semantics: Type of drink sweetener that may be used

enumeratedData.name: Modifiable
enumeratedData.semantics: Whether the dish is modifiable to remove each ingredient

fixedRecordData.name: ServiceStat
fixedRecordData.semantics: Check-off on whether the server performed properly on elements of the meal

variantRecordData.name: ServerValue

alternative.name: CoursePassed
alternative.semantics: Ratings scale for employees under training

variantRecordData.semantics: Datatype for server performance rating value

note.label: Note2
note.semantics: For most general-purpose restaurant simulations, this will be Subscribe only.

note.label: Note3
note.semantics: Merit raises are not provided according to any regular time interval; they are provided on a supervisor’s recommendation based on evidence of exceptional effort and performance.

note.label: Note4
note.semantics: Years of service are a factor in any merit raise. This value is only changed on the anniversary of the employee’s hire.

note.label: Note5
note.semantics: Sometimes a dish can be modified to be gluten- or wheat-free, e.g. gluten-free pasta can be used for some pasta dishes, but dishes like ravioli and lasagna are usually pre-made with wheat pasta and can’t be modified.

note.label: Note6
Note7
note.semantics: Gluten is found in three grains: wheat, barley, and rye. Gluten intolerant individuals will have varying degrees of negative, but not necessarily debilitating, reactions to these foods. Individuals with Celiac disease will have debilitating reactions to these foods and suffer long-term, potentially life-threatening effects. Those with wheat allergies may suffer immediate, life-threatening reactions, but may be able to eat barley and rye. Depending on levels of sensitivity, cross-contamination in the kitchen can be dangerous to the extent that separate food preparation areas and tools are required.
